description: This source file defines the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery module, which includes structures, static methods, and logic used to discover Tailscale gateways on a network. It involves network probing, JSON parsing of Tailscale status, and handling WebSocket connections to identify connect challenges.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers potential Tailscale gateway beacons within a specified timeout, probing candidate nodes via network checks and WebSocket challenges.

methods.name: collectCandidates
methods.description: Filters and gathers candidate nodes from the Tailscale status based on online status and unique DNS names.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to locate and run the tailscale executable to fetch the current network status as JSON.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path of a given executable candidate, checking for existence and accessibility.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs an external process asynchronously with a timeout, capturing its output.

methods.name: runBlocking
methods.description: Runs an external process synchronously, used internally by 'run'.

methods.name: commandEnvironment
methods.description: Prepares the environment variables for executing commands, ensuring TERM is set appropriately.

methods.name: parseStatus
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a TailscaleStatus object.

methods.name: probeHostForGatewayChallenge
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to a host to detect a gateway challenge event within a timeout.

methods.name: isConnectChallenge
methods.description: Detects if a WebSocket message indicates a connect challenge event.

calls: self.resolveExecutablePath(_:) failure to locate tailscale CLI
